doc.title: Sherrie Maricle interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 4, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]

title: Recommending bassist Pierre Boussaguet for French interviews
summary: Maricle recommends Pierre Boussaguet, a French bassist from her tour with Oliver Jones, in the style of Ray Brown.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Hey, Monk, there’s a — I did a tour with a great pianist named Oliver Jones, and the bass player on the gig was a French man named Pierre Boussaguet. I think he lives in Toulouse. And he did a duo record with Ray Brown and he’s very much in the style of Ray. He’s a great musician. He would be — if you’re looking for any Frenchmen, he swings his brains out. He’s great.
Great. I may ask you to spell that name out for me.
